description: This header file defines interfaces and components related to touchpad configuration within the Cuttlefish Android emulator project. It includes class declarations for managing touchpad configurations and their integration with command-line flags, utilizing the Fruit dependency injection framework.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigs
classes.description: An interface class for sharing and managing touchpad configuration data, including retrieving the name and configuration list, as well as setting new configurations.

classes.name: TouchpadsConfigsFlag
classes.description: A class representing a command-line flag feature to handle touchpad configurations.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the touchpad configuration component.

methods.name: GetConfigs
methods.description: Retrieves the current list of touchpad configurations.

methods.name: SetConfigs
methods.description: Sets the list of touchpad configurations.
